name: Office move in a weekend
result: Staff logged in Monday like nothing happened
alt: Floor plan of the new office with desks, server rack and Wi-Fi
story: A growing firm moved floors on a Friday. We planned the network, Wi-Fi and desks in advance, cabled over the weekend, and tested every seat on Sunday night.

page.timeline: Six weeks of planning, one weekend
challenge: A professional services firm of 40 people was moving two floors up in the same building. The lease set the date: out on Friday, open on Monday.
Their old office had grown one desk at a time. Nobody knew which cable went where, and the Wi-Fi had dead spots in both meeting rooms.

steps.title: Survey the new floor
steps.detail: We mapped Wi-Fi coverage and planned the cabling before the walls were closed.

steps.title: Order and stage
steps.detail: New switches and access points were set up and tested in our shop the week before.

steps.title: Move over the weekend
steps.detail: Cabling, the network rack and every desk went in on Saturday and Sunday.

steps.title: Test every seat
steps.detail: On Sunday night we signed in at each desk, printed a page and placed a call.

results: All 40 staff logged in on Monday with no tickets about the move.
Full Wi-Fi coverage, including both meeting rooms.
Every port and cable labelled and documented.
